title: Vectron: A Dynamic Programming Auto-vectorization Framework
problem: Dynamic programming algorithms (especially sequence alignment) are computation bottlenecks in genomics and other fields; hand-vectorization is tedious and error-prone. Auto-vectorization of array-based DP code is needed.
motivation: DP algorithms are widely used but computationally expensive; SIMD and GPU acceleration via auto-vectorization can deliver massive speedups without algorithm changes.
method: Vectron targets Python array-based DP implementations and auto-converts to vectorized C++ equivalents exploiting SIMD (CPU) and GPU parallelism. Processes multiple problem instances in parallel using SIMD/GPU primitives without requiring algorithm modifications.
key_novelty: Automatic vectorization of array-based DP from Python to SIMD/GPU-accelerated code without algorithm changes.
contributions: Auto-vectorization framework for Python array-based DP algorithms
SIMD and GPU parallelization without code rewriting
10-20x speedups over conventional C++ and manual implementations
limitations: Limited to array-based DP; other algorithmic patterns not discussed.
